title: Penguin dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ice floor -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91' rx='36' ry='6' fill='#bfe8ff'/>
  <!-- left flipper raised -->
  <path d='M30 50 Q18 40 20 28 Q28 36 34 46 Z' fill='#5c4a8a'/>
  <!-- right flipper raised -->
  <path d='M70 50 Q82 40 80 28 Q72 36 66 46 Z' fill='#5c4a8a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='23' ry='28' fill='#4a3a78'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='15' ry='21' fill='#f4f1ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='15' fill='#4a3a78'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#f4f1ff'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='32' r='2.6' fill='#2a2340'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='32' r='2.6' fill='#2a2340'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='31.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='31.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M50 37 L44 41 L50 44 L56 41 Z' fill='#ffa726'/>
  <!-- happy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='39' r='2' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='39' r='2' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='89' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ffa726'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='89' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ffa726'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <path d='M78 22 L78 32 M78 22 Q83 22 83 27' stroke='#ffe14a' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='33' r='3' fill='#ffe14a'/>
  <path d='M20 20 L20 29 M20 20 Q25 20 25 24' stroke='#7fe3ff' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='30' r='2.7' fill='#7fe3ff'/>
</svg>
